source_review.notes: Checked current Trino pushdown, connector-development, PostgreSQL connector, fault-tolerant-execution, and security documentation; current PostgreSQL postgres_fdw documentation; current BigQuery and Athena federation documentation; and primary Garlic, heterogeneous-source optimization, and Mariposa sources. All thirteen final references returned HTTP 200. Product behavior is attributed, and general federation guidance separates exact semantic requirements from deployment-specific capabilities.

evidence: Reviewed global query/source/snapshot-vector, source subplan/remainder, capability, pushed/residual predicate, transfer cost, and bind-join notation.
Reviewed startup, remote, request-latency, bandwidth, wire/decode/local, queueing, throttling, retry, and uncertainty components.
Checked Boolean/three-valued implications, byte/time units, positive bandwidth/batch sizes, request ceilings, and snapshot scope.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Remote and global semantics, source snapshots, physical transfer, and arbitrary optimizer costs remain distinct.

evidence: Executed the Python 3 fixture and reproduced unfiltered_bytes=1200000000, filtered_bytes=24000000, transfer_seconds=0.24, estimated_seconds=1.57, and reduction_percent=98.0.
Recomputed 8,200 distinct bind keys in batches of 500 as 17 requests before retry.
Recomputed Exercise 2 as 6,000,000,000 unfiltered bytes, 30,000,000 filtered bytes, 0.375 transfer seconds, and 2.525 estimated seconds.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Transfer arithmetic omits queueing, contention, throttling, retries, conversion, cleanup, uncertainty, and semantic legality unless explicitly added.

evidence: Verified source subplans plus engine remainder must equal the global query over the declared snapshot vector.
Verified a conservative remote predicate requires every globally qualifying row to survive remote filtering before exact residual evaluation.
Verified bind-join request count is ceil(distinct keys/batch size) while final join multiplicity remains based on original rows.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Pushdown exactness, conservative filtering, residual completion, cost desirability, and source authorization are separate claims.

evidence: Reviewed empty/huge results, partial pages, stale/absent statistics, compressed expansion, many round trips, hot sources, and quota changes.
Reviewed nulls, case/collation, time zones, decimals, NaN, JSON/arrays, identifiers, duplicates, ordering, limits/top-N, functions, aggregates, and errors.
Reviewed schema/source upgrades, snapshot-token loss, retries, cancellation, throttling, timeout, unavailable sources, malformed pages, credential rotation, policy changes, and cleanup failure.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Unknown semantics, incomplete input, lost consistency, unauthorized operations, or exceeded bounds fail or fall back rather than silently weakening the result.

evidence: Traced global objects to connector, remote identity, metadata/capability epoch, types, authority, source transaction, and lineage.
Checked residual predicates, exact/conservative guarantees, physical properties, immutable handles, typed parameters, and repeated optimizer invocation behavior.
Checked one selected attempt per split/page, snapshot-aware retry, bounded connections/requests/bytes/state, backpressure, audit, and explicit partial-result semantics.
invariant_checking.notes: A common query surface does not erase source autonomy, semantic differences, consistency boundaries, or policy intersection.

evidence: Reviewed the ten-step decomposition audit from global binding and capability negotiation through safe pushdown, placement, bounded execution, and verification.
Checked full and conservative predicate-pushdown obligations and analogous multiplicity/order constraints for aggregate, join, limit, and top-N.
Checked why source-local repeatable reads produce a snapshot vector rather than a globally simultaneous snapshot without coordination.
proof_review.notes: Semantic equivalence, snapshot claims, authorization, source protection, failure behavior, and economics are reviewed independently.

evidence: Audited federated query, connector/wrapper, source autonomy, capability negotiation, pushdown, residual, pass-through, decomposition, snapshot vector, data shipping, query shipping, and semi-join terminology.
Confirmed federation, ingestion, replication, external tables, virtualization, caching/materialization, and native pass-through are differentiated.
Confirmed central joins, remote staging, bind joins, semi-join filters, and exact final joins are not conflated.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Each mechanism identifies semantic owner, snapshot, authority, movement, state, and cleanup boundaries.

evidence: Reviewed metadata/planning calls, remote queue/start/first-byte/last-byte, requests, rows, wire/decoded bytes, residual work, CPU/memory/spill, backpressure, retries, source load, tails, and cost.
Confirmed no universal connection limit, concurrency, batch size, timeout, retry count, bandwidth, selectivity, cache TTL, or pushdown threshold is prescribed.
Confirmed production claims require pushed/unpushed differential tests, realistic network/source-load cohorts, shadow rules, per-connector/source canaries, kill switches, and rollback.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: High pushdown percentage or reduced wire bytes is not mislabeled end-to-end latency, source safety, global consistency, or fleet value.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed architecture distinctions, global catalog/mappings, capabilities, type normalization, pushdown/residual proof, decomposition, cost, placement, cross-source joins, snapshot vectors, writes, source protection, identity/policy, failures/partial results, observability, and validation.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementable metadata/capability epochs, immutable source handles, invocation-specific exactness, typed binding, residual retention, source affinity, network/source-aware costs, snapshot acquisition and retry, bounded pools, backpressure, delegated credentials, explain attribution, conformance suites, canaries, and rollback. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from federation boundaries through semantic pushdown, global planning, consistency, operations, security, and validation. Ten examples and five answered exercises cover residuals, collation, snapshot vectors, bind batching, source protection, movement cost, stale statistics, partial failure, retry consistency, executable costing, connector contracts, three-source joins, and rollout.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external Trino/PostgreSQL/BigQuery/Athena maintainer, Garlic/Mariposa researcher, connector/source operator, optimizer/database/distributed-systems/network/platform/SRE/performance/security/governance specialist, affected user, accessibility specialist, or certification review is claimed.
